# Contract: `allocation_scope` on the number pool

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Data model**: [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Status**: GraphQL schema modification (ask-first list). Generated by the generic generator from
the core schema definition; the only hand-written part is the validation in
`graphql/mutations/resource_manager.py::InfrahubNumberPoolMutation`.

This contract is published first and frozen: no later story in the slice renames, retypes or
removes a field below (FR-018).

## Changed object type

```graphql
type CoreNumberPool implements CoreNode & CoreResourcePool & LineageSource {
  allocation_scope: ListAttribute
  # every other field unchanged
}
```

`ListAttribute.value` is the list of entries as stored, normalised to bare field names. Absent and
empty both read as unscoped; the read value for an unscoped pool is `null` or `[]` and clients MUST
treat the two alike.

## Changed inputs

```graphql
input CoreNumberPoolCreateInput { allocation_scope: ListAttributeCreate }
input CoreNumberPoolUpdateInput { allocation_scope: ListAttributeUpdate }
input CoreNumberPoolUpsertInput { allocation_scope: ListAttributeUpdate }
```

The input types are the generated list-attribute inputs every `List` attribute already uses.

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| omitted | create: unscoped; update: unchanged |
| `{value: []}` | unscoped |
| `{value: null}` on update | clears the scope |
| `{value: ["site"]}` | scoped by the `site` relationship |
| `{value: ["site", "role__value"]}` | scoped by `site` and the `role` attribute; stored as `["site", "role"]` |

## Validation (mutation branch's schema)

Refused with a `ValidationError` on the `allocation_scope` field naming the entry:

| Entry | Reason given |
|---|---|
| optional attribute or relationship | must be required on the kind |
| many relationship | must be of cardinality one |
| `site__name__value` | cannot use attributes of a related node, only the relationship |
| list or JSON attribute | must be a single scalar value |
| the pool's own `node_attribute` | cannot scope a pool by the attribute it allocates |
| repeated entry | duplicate |
| unknown on this branch | not defined on the kind |
| unchanged (the normalised submitted scope equals the stored value) | accepted on every branch without re-validation, so a pool re-sent whole from a branch that lacks an entry is not refused |

On a pool whose `pool_type` is `Schema`, any change to `allocation_scope` is refused with the
existing message pointing at the schema in the default branch.

## Examples

```graphql
mutation {
  CoreNumberPoolCreate(data: {
    name: {value: "VLAN per site"}
    node: {value: "InfraDevice"}
    node_attribute: {value: "vlan_id"}
    start_range: {value: 1}
    end_range: {value: 100}
    allocation_scope: {value: ["site"]}
  }) { ok object { id allocation_scope { value } } }
}
```

```graphql
mutation { CoreNumberPoolUpdate(data: {id: "…", allocation_scope: {value: null}}) { ok } }
```
